issue.positionEn: Give a work a new setting and you change how people approach it, wear it or listen to it.
issue.introEn: Athens has reopened its Old Acropolis Museum. At Giza, Jiang Qiong Er arranged twelve sculptures along a path, while David Sims spread thirty-five years of photographs across nine rooms. This issue follows what happens when people can enter those spaces, and looks at a Tokyo pop-up, a fleece collaboration, flag football and the music inside a video game.
issue.closingEn: The Giza exhibition runs through November 28. Athens’s Old Acropolis Museum has just reopened, while the David Sims exhibition in A Coruña runs into May. Follow the original exhibition pages for more views and visiting details.
